note: Hooded rogue, front view. Head is the dark hood with face and full beard, bottom edge y~424 at the beard; the pink neck, hoodie front, shoulder patches, belt, sheaths and the long coat skirts are torso. Arms are short stumps: sleeves run from the shoulder to y556 (left) and y566 (right) where the brown cuffs begin, the brown cuffs are forearm (to y622/624), and the pale fists below are the hands (left y622-680, right y624-682). Each hand holds a dagger point-down and outward, labelled equipment: the blade with the brown pommel that sticks out below the fist and its dark outline, kept off the hand. Hip is the coat hem y790; the bare skin between hem and boot top (y790-808) is thigh; boots have tall shafts so the knee is the boot top y808 on both legs; ankle at the instep y862.
